content_blocks.text: This lesson focuses on **Pandas and NumPy Interoperability**. Work through the listed subtopics (Understanding the shared data ecosystem, Converting objects to NumPy arrays, Using NumPy functions on Series and DataFrames, Understanding index and label behavior) as decisions in one small data workflow: identify the input and its labels, choose the relevant Pandas operation, then inspect the output shape, values, and types. Do not assume the result is correct solely because the code ran.

content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3])
print(np.asarray(s).tolist())

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Avoid assuming inferred types are always correct, treating every repeated record as an error, or overlooking alignment by labels. Check the actual API documentation for the target version and assert the properties that matter to the task.
